label: Humanitarian Now
description: Focus on sources, sectors, action cards, and live reports.
openingQuestion: What is happening now, and what evidence supports it?
suggestedNextStep: Open one sector and inspect source badges.
recommendedAction: Review an action card before sharing or supporting.
whatToShare: A sourced sector briefing with review status visible.

label: Responsible Action
description: Focus on action pathways, organizations, trust evidence, and safeguards.
suggestedNextStep: Compare an action pathway with a Transparency Passport.
recommendedAction: Use official channels only where a reviewed route exists.
whatToShare: A donor checklist and caveat-aware action card.

label: Learn What Is Needed
description: Focus on capacity gaps, learning pathways, resources, and competencies.
openingQuestion: What capacities are needed before acting?
suggestedNextStep: Build a learning path matched to issue, role, and time.
recommendedAction: Create a reviewable artifact before external action.
recommendedLearningPath: Role-based pathway matched to issue and goal.
whatToShare: A learning pathway, checklist, or workshop agenda.

label: Practice Through Simulation
description: Focus on decision practice before public or field-facing action.
openingQuestion: How can I practice before acting?
suggestedNextStep: Run one simulation connected to the pathway.
recommendedAction: Use the simulation output to create a safer action plan.
whatToShare: A scenario reflection or action checklist.

label: Peacebuilding Lens
description: Focus on conflict transformation, trauma, social psychology, youth leadership, and long-term civic repair.
openingQuestion: What becomes visible when humanitarian need is viewed relationally and historically?
suggestedNextStep: Use the Lens Explorer with one sector.
recommendedAction: Design safer learning spaces and avoid manipulative narrative work.
whatToShare: A lens interpretation with caveats and safeguards.

label: Future Capacity
description: Focus on time horizons, future capacity, action ripples, and deep time.
openingQuestion: How can urgent action connect to the long arc?
suggestedNextStep: Find your horizon, then explore action ripples.
recommendedAction: Choose a responsible action with 30-day and 25-year meaning.

label: Stakeholder / Partner View
description: Focus on executive overview, demo, briefing, methodology, readiness, and review tracks.
openingQuestion: Is this credible enough to review, fund, pilot, or advise?
suggestedNextStep: Open the executive one-pager and readiness page.
recommendedAction: Identify a review track or partner role.
